content.json:
## RequestHub notification worker
The worker delivers the notifications that RequestHub creates when a request is submitted, commented on, rerouted, or decided. A healthy worker delivers each one within a few seconds.

The alert **RequestHub notification backlog** fires when the oldest pending notification is older than __THRESHOLD__ seconds. Azure SRE Agent picks it up and investigates.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.oldest_pending_age_seconds"
| summarize ["Oldest pending (s)"] = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Oldest pending notification (seconds). Alert threshold: __THRESHOLD__

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.pending"
| summarize Pending = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Pending notifications

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.processed"
| summarize Delivered = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Notifications delivered per minute

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Notification backlog"
| project timestamp, message
| order by timestamp desc
| take 20
content.title: Worker backlog reports (workerDelayFaultActive shows an injected fault)

content.query:
ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__WORKER_APP_NAME__"
| project TimeGenerated, Revision = RevisionName_s, Reason = Reason_s, Message = Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 30
content.title: Worker revisions and container events (a configuration change creates a new revision)
